title: add benchmark-lab profiling baselines and representative workload runners + reporting pipeline v52
author: Aisha Thompson
description: Motivation: provide repeatable profiling baselines and representative workload runners for the benchmark-lab so we can track regressions across kernel/runtime changes and quantify the impact of batching/quantization policies. This PR adds: 1) a set of profiling baselines (cpu/gpu/memory traces + flamegraphs) for the common model families we serve; 2) representative workload runners that mirror production prefix distributions and sequence lengths; 3) an Airflow reporting pipeline that aggregates run outputs and uploads summarized metrics to BigQuery and the benchmark-lab dashboard. Checklist: - [x] Add profiling harness and baselines for llm-family-a, llm-family-b - [x] Add representative workload runners with configurable load profiles - [x] Add Dockerfiles and k8s job manifests for runners - [x] Add Airflow DAG + BigQuery reporting tasks - [x] Add CI job to run lightweight smoke benchmarks on PRs - [x] Add migration script to backfill baseline table - [ ] Follow-up: docs update and onboarding guide (tracked separately) Commits summary: implemented harness, added runners, added reporting DAG, CI integration, tests and small performance tweaks. Please see commit list below for details. Backwards compatibility: all changes are additive. The reporting pipeline writes to a new dataset and uses a feature flag in benchmark-lab-config for rollout. Deployment notes: - Run `scripts/benchmark_lab/backfill_baselines.sh` once after deployment to populate baseline table for historical runs. - The Airflow DAG is gated behind the `benchmark_lab.reporting.enabled` feature flag. - Runners are containerized; images are published under redwood/benchmark-lab:stable-v52. Related: ENG-3214 (baseline tracking), SUP-1874 (support request for profiling artifacts).
commits: add: profiling harness and baseline exporters
chore: Dockerfiles and k8s job manifests for benchmark-lab
feat: airflow DAG for reporting + BigQuery sink
test: add lightweight smoke benchmarks to CI
fix: reduce memory footprint for runner by streaming buffers
review_comments: Diego Martinez: Please reduce peak memory usage for the GPU runner — I saw OOM at 24k tokens on g4dn.xlarge. Can we stream KV cache and avoid full context copies?
Aisha Thompson: Good catch — pushed a fix that streams the buffer and reduces peak by ~40% (see commit 'fix: reduce memory footprint for runner by streaming buffers').
Priya Desai: Can the reporting DAG be split into ingest + aggregate tasks? Large DAGs make retries expensive. Suggest splitting and adding idempotency keys.
Aisha Thompson: Split the DAG into ingest/aggregate tasks and added idempotency on BigQuery writes (upsert by run_id). Updated DAG in commit 'feat: airflow DAG for reporting + BigQuery sink'.
Evan Wu: Approve after the memory fix and DAG split. Verified baseline artifacts format matches existing benchmark-lab schema.
release_notes: Add profiling baselines and representative workload runners; new Airflow reporting pipeline for benchmark-lab (writes to bigquery). Additive changes only. Feature gated behind benchmark_lab.reporting.enabled.
notes: This PR unblocks automated nightly profiling runs and provides data for the optimizer team to recommend quantization/batching profiles. Follow-up tasks: docs onboarding (ENG-3341) and dashboard filters (ENG-3298).
